719-3510-4288-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-3510-4288-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

671-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
671-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Daxos triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

1170-3120-8164.easyPrerequisites:
Mindsplice Apparatus has at least two oil counters on it.
Heartwood Crafter is prepared.
1170-3120-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

1268-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with different powers.

296-3532-5078-8176.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4699-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-6094.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

348-1152-4867-6026-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4867-6026-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Field of Souls triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2043-5434-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-5434-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1115-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1115-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1115-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1017-1494-1742-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1558-3147-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3532-5078-7010-7314.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1069-3552-4742-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-4742-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

2478-5660-6701.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mishra's Bauble ability.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1012-4871-5220-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-4871-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2060-4929-5296-6995.description:
Activate Lulu by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler, Workhorse and Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Crystalline Crawler and Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from them, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2059-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-313-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-3967.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

56-789-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-789-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Gutter Grime and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-789-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

3951-4192-5703-6798.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4192-5703-6798.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

567-1981-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
567-1981-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4484-4871-5643-6556.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3967-4484-4871-5643-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
3967-4484-4871-5643-6556.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3967-4484-4871-5643-6556.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1247-5536-5845.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness and is modified.
Orochi Merge-Keeper and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5845.description:
Activate Rex using Orochi Merge-Keeper's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2427-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1032-2178-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1032-2178-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1032-1857-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1032-1857-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

240-643-2689-3466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
240-643-2689-3466.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control by any method.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Reaper King triggers, destroying that creature.
Resolve Atla Palani's trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until Hostility enters the battlefield then dies, or until you choose to end the loop by destroying an opponent's permanent.
If Hostility dies, it and Atla Palani trigger.
Resolve Hostility's trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Continue from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
1849-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1272-1303-2232-2766.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Swamp and at least one Forest that enter the battlefield untapped.
You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
You have at least one Swamp card and at least one Forest card that enter the battlefield untapped in your graveyard.
1272-1303-2232-2766.description:
Activate a Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
When Molderhulk enters the battlefield, it, Necroduality and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Molderhulk.
When the Molderhulk token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the token Molderhulk's trigger, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Swamp enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another Swamp from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger from step 4, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Seismic Assault twice by discarding the Swamp and Forest, dealing 4 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1530-2928-3544-4428.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-2928-3544-4428.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

1806-2060-3129-4204.description:
Activate Varolz by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, regenerating Varolz.
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability by paying {3} and exiling it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2557-3719-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with power seven or greater.
2557-3719-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a nontoken creature you control with power seven or greater, and create at least fourteen Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing at least seven Treasures, returning a nontoken creature you control with power seven or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
